cut_rule.method: Every segment boundary is a 1/24 s frame boundary k/24 chosen inside measured master silence. Primary: 5 ms RMS blocks below -55 dBFS form the silent run between the outgoing word and the next word; the frame nearest the run centre with at least 30 ms margin to sound. Fallback where the run is shorter than 60 ms: the frame whose +/-21 ms window has the lowest RMS inside [previous word end - 60 ms, next word start + 40 ms]. Every cut window measures below -50 dBFS (out_cue.cut_window_rms_dbfs). Word alignment proposes; the waveform chose.
cut_rule.rounding: master_in and master_out are exact multiples of 1/24 s written to 6 decimals, except the final master_out 1233.602 (the master end). Frames are half-open [round(master_in*24), round(master_out*24)); the final segment ends at frame ceil(1233.602*24)=29607, i.e. 1233.625 s picture, and the assembler pads 0.023 s of digital silence after the untouched master audio.
cut_rule.continuous_boundaries: seg010/seg011 (one sting composition), seg064/seg065 (one act4 composition), seg072/seg073 (take P18, crop change only), seg074/seg075 (take P19, crop change only) are not picture cuts of source media.

assembly.method: EP007 R56 method: ffmpeg single filter graph, trim by frame, atrim by sample (2000 samples per frame), 1280x720 24 fps setsar=1, stereo 48 kHz, concat; libx264 crf 16 + aac 256k, faststart. Every segment's audio is the master excerpt at its own master range; presenter audio is always the restored original narration aligned to the master, never the provider's native voice.

establishing_stills.prompt: Photographic documentary still, 16:9, eye-level locked-off medium-wide shot across the reception counter of a small, well-kept 20-room country inn in the United States, spring morning daylight from a window at screen right that looks out onto a wooded walking trail behind the property. Behind the counter, right of centre: the innkeeper, a woman in her mid-40s, dark hair tied back, olive-green knit cardigan over a cream shirt. At the counter, screen left, three-quarter back to camera: the guest, a man in his late 30s, short brown hair, navy rain shell, a daypack on one shoulder, his right hand near a brass room key on the counter. On the counter: an open laptop angled so its screen faces her and is not visible to camera, a desk bell, a small jar of daffodils, a short stack of blank registration cards with a pen, and at the counter's left end nearest the entrance an open cloth-bound guest book with a pen in its gutter, pages unreadable. A wooden key rack on the wall behind her. Lived-in, modest, not luxury. No logos, no readable text anywhere, no other people. Natural neutral grade.
review_checks: guest book, registration cards, laptop angle and window trail all present
faces and wardrobe distinct from EP007's workshop cast
counter geography leaves room for the guest to exit left
